workout_summary: Arms, 18:20 (followed the report's recommended Arms day): Incline hammer curl 18kg each×4×8 (ties best); Incline DB curl 18kg each×4×5 (ties best); Half curl 16kg each×4×6 (ties best); Forearm twists 12kg each×4×10 (ties best); Dead hang 20s×3 (PR — same duration as prior best but at a heavier bodyweight, 81.25kg); Biceps curl machine 45kg×2×6 (fewer sets, not a PR); Plank 45s×1 (longer single hold, lower total volume than the 3×30s best).
status_note: Day complete. Slept ~9.75h (23:15-09:00) — a long, solid recovery night. Weigh-in: 81.25 kg (-0.30 kg vs 17 Jul), body fat 27.2%, resting HR back down to 62 bpm. Double espresso at 10:10, a big lunch at 13:30 (potatoes in olive oil, 250g denis fish baked with butter, lettuce/tomato/onion/mozzarella salad with homemade vinaigrette, baked onion and tomatoes), multivitamin and another double espresso at 16:00/16:05, 350g honeydew melon at 16:30, an Arms workout at 18:20 (Dead Hang PR at heavier bodyweight; 4 exercises tied bests), dinner at 19:35 (2 protein spelt pitas, yellow cheese, Simfonia cheese spread, 2 fried eggs, white cabbage salad in lemon), omega-3 and creatine at 20:25/21:45, and a grapes + yellow cheese snack at 22:30. Final totals: ~2,345 kcal, ~166g protein, ~196g carb, ~111g fat, ~44g fiber, 4 caffeine shots — a big, protein-forward training day; fish and multivitamin cleared every micro target comfortably. ACWR now in the danger zone (1.7) after today's Arms session — hold volume flat or deload next time; recommended next session is Back day.
